description: Ground truth planted in the Halden sample. The engine's tests check its ranking against this.

critical_paths.why: A laptop compromised through a vulnerable MCP client (CVE-2025-6514) can call an unauthenticated MCP shell tool whose host runs as an AWS admin role. The decisive hops are misconfigurations, not CVEs.
Prompt injection in the public chat can drive CRM write and external email tools: customer data exfiltration. No CVE involved.
A forged invoice can make the agent change vendor bank details and schedule payment. No CVE involved.
Known-exploited Ivanti flaw on the VPN, then Zerologon on the domain controller.
Known-exploited ScreenConnect auth bypass gives a session as a shared Domain Admin without MFA.
Known-exploited Spring4Shell on an internet-facing portal with direct access to the orders database.

decoys.why: Critical or known-exploited CVEs on isolated lab systems: high CVSS, no path to a crown jewel. A good ranking keeps them out of the top 10.
